## Core Competencies & Tech Stack
- **Frontend Engineering:** React, Next.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 Semantic Architecture, Vanilla CSS, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Responsive UX/UI.
- **Backend & APIs:** Node.js, Express.js, RESTful API design, WebSocket real-time communication (Socket.io), microservice architecture.
- **Databases & Storage:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis (caching and pub/sub), Prisma ORM, Cloudflare R2 object storage.
- **Security & Auth:** JWT RS256 token architectures, OTP authentication, Clerk Auth integration, secure payment flows.
- **Automation & Systems:** Linux/Bash scripting, automated data collection pipelines, OpenAI GPT integration for automated processing, Git workflow.
- **Payment Integrations:** Telr Payment Gateway API.

## Featured Case Studies & Production Systems
- [Bin Aqar Platform](https://rayanmeziti.com/project/binaqar): Full-scale Saudi real estate marketplace and custom CRM delivered in 1.5 months. Engineered with 15 API modules, Telr payment gateway, Socket.io real-time chat, bilingual interface, and affiliate commission management. (Client: Riyad Moussa, April 2026).
- [Wazayefksa Job Board](https://rayanmeziti.com/project/wazayefksa): Saudi recruitment platform featuring automated job crawlers, automated GPT rewriting pipelines, multi-role admin/employer dashboards, and SEO optimization. (Client: ALSAHLI, KHUZAYYIM ALHUMAIDA K, December 2025).
- [Algérie Télécom Platform](https://rayanmeziti.com/project/algerietelecom): Centralized software deployment and workstation package distribution platform built for enterprise infrastructure. (Client: Algérie Télécom, June 2026).
